daily.visitors: SELECT count(DISTINCT distinct_id) FROM events WHERE event = '$pageview' AND properties.$host IN ('corvus.gent', 'www.corvus.gent', 'stats.corvus.gent') AND timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-11-02 00:00:00') AND toDate(toTimeZone(timestamp, 'Europe/Brussels')) = toDate('__CORVUS_STATS_DAY__')
daily.total: SELECT sum(c) FROM (SELECT count(DISTINCT distinct_id) c FROM events WHERE event = '$pageview' AND properties.$host IN ('corvus.gent', 'www.corvus.gent', 'stats.corvus.gent') AND timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-11-02 00:00:00') AND toDate(toTimeZone(timestamp, 'Europe/Brussels')) <= toDate('__CORVUS_STATS_DAY__') GROUP BY toDate(toTimeZone(timestamp, 'Europe/Brussels')))
daily.hours: SELECT toHour(toTimeZone(timestamp, 'Europe/Brussels')) h, count(DISTINCT distinct_id) n FROM events WHERE event = '$pageview' AND properties.$host IN ('corvus.gent', 'www.corvus.gent', 'stats.corvus.gent') AND timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-11-02 00:00:00') AND toDate(toTimeZone(timestamp, 'Europe/Brussels')) = toDate('__CORVUS_STATS_DAY__') GROUP BY h ORDER BY h
daily.countries: SELECT coalesce(nullIf(properties.corvus_country_code, ''), nullIf(properties.$geoip_country_code, ''), nullIf(properties.$geoip_country_name, ''), '?') c, count(DISTINCT distinct_id) n FROM events WHERE event = '$pageview' AND properties.$host IN ('corvus.gent', 'www.corvus.gent', 'stats.corvus.gent') AND timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-11-02 00:00:00') AND toDate(toTimeZone(timestamp, 'Europe/Brussels')) = toDate('__CORVUS_STATS_DAY__') GROUP BY c ORDER BY n DESC, c ASC LIMIT 300
daily.sources: SELECT multiIf(properties.links_source IS NOT NULL, properties.links_source, properties.utm_source IS NOT NULL, properties.utm_source, properties.$referring_domain LIKE '%instagram%', 'instagram', properties.$referring_domain LIKE '%linkedin%' OR properties.$referring_domain = 'lnkd.in', 'linkedin', properties.$referring_domain LIKE '%tiktok%', 'tiktok', properties.$referring_domain LIKE '%facebook%', 'facebook', properties.$referring_domain LIKE '%discord%', 'discord', properties.$referring_domain IN ('t.co', 'x.com', 'twitter.com'), 'x', properties.$referring_domain IN ('$direct', '') OR properties.$referring_domain IS NULL, 'direct', properties.$referring_domain) s, count() n FROM events WHERE event = '$pageview' AND properties.$host IN ('corvus.gent', 'www.corvus.gent', 'stats.corvus.gent') AND timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-11-02 00:00:00') AND toDate(toTimeZone(timestamp, 'Europe/Brussels')) = toDate('__CORVUS_STATS_DAY__') AND coalesce(properties.$referring_domain, '') NOT LIKE '%corvus.gent' GROUP BY s ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 6
daily.browsers: SELECT coalesce(properties.$browser, '?') b, count(DISTINCT distinct_id) n FROM events WHERE event = '$pageview' AND properties.$host IN ('corvus.gent', 'www.corvus.gent', 'stats.corvus.gent') AND timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-11-02 00:00:00') AND toDate(toTimeZone(timestamp, 'Europe/Brussels')) = toDate('__CORVUS_STATS_DAY__') GROUP BY b ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 6
daily.pages: SELECT properties.$pathname p, count() n FROM events WHERE event = '$pageview' AND properties.$host IN ('corvus.gent', 'www.corvus.gent', 'stats.corvus.gent') AND timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-11-02 00:00:00') AND toDate(toTimeZone(timestamp, 'Europe/Brussels')) = toDate('__CORVUS_STATS_DAY__') GROUP BY p ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 5
daily.feathers: SELECT count(), count(DISTINCT distinct_id) FROM events WHERE event = 'feather_found' AND properties.$host IN ('corvus.gent', 'www.corvus.gent', 'stats.corvus.gent') AND timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-11-02 00:00:00') AND toDate(toTimeZone(timestamp, 'Europe/Brussels')) = toDate('__CORVUS_STATS_DAY__')
daily.terminal: SELECT properties.command c, count() n FROM events WHERE event = 'terminal_command' AND properties.$host IN ('corvus.gent', 'www.corvus.gent', 'stats.corvus.gent') AND timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-11-02 00:00:00') AND toDate(toTimeZone(timestamp, 'Europe/Brussels')) = toDate('__CORVUS_STATS_DAY__') GROUP BY c ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 3

pidgy.crossings: SELECT count(DISTINCT if(event='$pageview',distinct_id,NULL)), count(DISTINCT if(event='outbound_click' AND properties.host IN ('pidgy-ai.com','app.pidgy-ai.com'),distinct_id,NULL)), countIf(event='outbound_click' AND properties.host IN ('pidgy-ai.com','app.pidgy-ai.com')), count(DISTINCT if(event='$pageview' AND toDate(toTimeZone(timestamp,'Europe/Brussels'))=toDate('__CORVUS_STATS_DAY__'),distinct_id,NULL)), count(DISTINCT if(event='outbound_click' AND properties.host IN ('pidgy-ai.com','app.pidgy-ai.com') AND toDate(toTimeZone(timestamp,'Europe/Brussels'))=toDate('__CORVUS_STATS_DAY__'),distinct_id,NULL)), countIf(event='outbound_click' AND properties.host IN ('pidgy-ai.com','app.pidgy-ai.com') AND toDate(toTimeZone(timestamp,'Europe/Brussels'))=toDate('__CORVUS_STATS_DAY__')) FROM events WHERE properties.$host IN ('corvus.gent', 'www.corvus.gent', 'stats.corvus.gent') AND timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-11-02 00:00:00')
